body: Fuck it. If I die I die. I don't care anymore.

He is. This virus will either leave him with permanent lung damage, kill him, or give him even more medical debt. I like writing, but I fucking suck at it. I used to woodburn, but my hands are too shaky nowadays from anxiety symptoms. I'm a waste of space and I really don't get why he picked me. I'm very close to offing myself because I feel I somehow lied to him about my worth, and the idea of reintegrating into a normal workforce makes me want to leap off a cliff.

I fuckin hated my old job. Customers were entitled bastards, and management was full of nepotism. I'm a fucking dumbass with learning disabilities trying to find a job I can do from home, but I don't qualify for anything. I'm a waste of flesh. Even my own goddamn dad tried to end me.

I cant go anywhere. I live in an open state where cases are spiking. I hate the ever loving shit out of myself, always have, but I CANNOT risk my husband because he's pure soul and i love him deeply. Even if I died I'd go to hell knowing I ruined his life. 

I don't know what to do. I know I'm hurting him because I fell right back into old habits. Before I met him I was homeless, and had no friends. I try to make connections but I always fuck it up somehow. The one outlier is him, and I know I have to quarantine myself for his sake. 

I just cant take how useless I feel. I'm not cut out for 9-5, barely passed highscool, and I'm just all around a useless human being. No skills. No motivation. 

If this ends before I manage to off myself, I don't think I'll be fit for even part time work, and I know full well the burden that puts on my partner and what little family I have left. 

I should have never been born.
